name: owt-browser
description: Online Weekly Tournament Series: browser edition. 100-player Melee stamina royale, played in the browser.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm test -w packages/shared && npm test -w packages/engine && npm test -w apps/api
